identity_check: Bar reads MORGAN LEIGH BLACK (left name) / BRIANNA STE-MARIE (right name) from 0:10 onward, but the NAME ORDER DOES NOT MATCH physical mat position here (the exact trap the protocol warns about): the white/light kit with 'BLACK'/'BIGHORN' text printed on the back sits on the physical RIGHT of the mat from ~65s on -- that is Morgan Black. The dark kit with a green ankle band sits on the physical LEFT -- that is Brianna Ste-Marie (same green-band marker she wears in her other audited bout this batch). Identity bound to the kit text/band, not to bar position. Result matches BJJ Heroes ground truth: Morgan Black L Guillotine, World NoGi 61KG F 2024.
